facts.fact: Adwave says its streaming TV placement covers 100+ networks and starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: put that same commercial on real streaming TV across 100+ networks through Adwave, from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Wavemaker generates video in 16:9 by default, with 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 available when needed, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: Wavemaker generates in 16:9 by default (plus 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 when you need them)

facts.fact: Wavemaker builds a storyboard from one of 21 presets, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: From the script, the AI builds a storyboard using one of 21 presets

facts.fact: Adwave states that Wavemaker takes two to five minutes to produce most videos.
facts.quote: Two to five minutes for most videos.

facts.fact: Adwave says custom AI voice design is available on Wavemaker's Pro plan and higher.
facts.quote: with custom voice design available on Pro and up

facts.fact: Adwave characterizes traditional TV commercial production as requiring a five-figure budget and a production house.
facts.quote: For decades, making a TV commercial meant a five-figure budget, a production house, and a calendar full of shoots and revisions.

facts.fact: Adwave describes Wavemaker's output as a finished 30-second spot.
facts.quote: You get a finished 30-second spot in minutes.

facts.fact: Adwave can run a finished Wavemaker video as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks starting at $30 a day, according to the page.
facts.quote: a finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ premium networks through Adwave, from $30 a day.

facts.fact: The page states that airing a finished commercial through Adwave on 100+ streaming networks starts from $50, with local or national targeting and live analytics.
facts.quote: from $50, with local or national targeting and live analytics.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the page says is enough for a first commercial.
facts.quote: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which is enough for your first spot

facts.fact: Free Wavemaker exports are limited to 480p resolution and include a watermark.
facts.quote: though free exports are 480p with a watermark

facts.fact: Wavemaker paid plans start at $29 per month and support exports up to 4K resolution.
facts.quote: Paid plans start at $29/mo and support exports up to 4K.

facts.fact: The page says most Wavemaker videos generate in two to five minutes once an input such as a prompt or website URL is provided.
facts.quote: Most videos generate in two to five minutes once you've given Wavemaker an input

facts.fact: The workflow described on the page ends with exporting a finished 30-second commercial.
The page claims traditional TV commercial production ran into the tens of thousands of dollars before any airtime was purchased.
facts.quote: Traditional TV production ran into the tens of thousands of dollars before you spent a cent on airtime

facts.fact: Adwave's connected TV distribution is described as including networks such as NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: alongside networks like NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.

facts.fact: Through Adwave, the same finished Wavemaker commercial can also run on Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display channels.
facts.quote: the same finished commercial can also run on Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, and display.
